verdict.rationale: Mercury's docs.mercury.com/reference hub is a ReadMe-based interactive API reference with a live 'Try It!' request runner, language-specific code samples (Shell, Node, Ruby, PHP, Python), Bearer auth field, and real endpoint schemas, backed by a sandbox environment for safe testing. This is corroborated by probes confirming the reference page loads and the sandbox base URLs work. Missing for 10: publicly downloadable OpenAPI spec (confirmed 404/admin-only via probes), and no independent hands-on account of actually running examples through the 'Try It' button.
